displayName: OCI-AI-GOV-027: AI — Safety Override Without Authorization
description:
Detects safety override or bypass of AI safety controls without proper authorization

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_gov_027", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%safety%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%override%') AND "value" > 0
